text:
sara-support: Customer report — tool invoke returns 400 with schema validation errors when calling payments_tool. Customer: ACME-Widgets (hosted). Error shows additionalProperties and missing required billing.customer_id. Raising for triage. https://app.zendesk.com/tickets/7654321

james: can you paste the original request body + the gateway request_id and the api key prefix?

sara-support: request_id: req_2024-06-11_18:55:23_9abf
Here is the body we proxied to the tool (redacted):
```json
{"tool": "payments_tool", "tool_args": {"order_id": "ord_9933", "amount": "100.00", "currency": "USD", "promo_code": "SUMMER24"}, "billing": {"line_items": [{"name":"widget","unit_price":"100"}], "receipt_email": "cust@example.com"}}
```

sara-support: And the error from the validator: `400 Bad Request {"errors": [{"keyword":"additionalProperties","dataPath":"/tool_args","message":"unexpected property 'promo_code'"},{"keyword":"required","dataPath":"/billing","message":"missing required property 'customer_id'"},{"keyword":"type","dataPath":"/tool_args/amount","message":"should be number"}]}`

lena: :eyes: thanks. Quick notes — payments_tool schema expects amount: number (not string), promo_code is not allowed on hosted catalog variant (we recently tightened additionalProperties in v1.2 of the func schema), and billing.customer_id is required for hosted billing routing. Looks like client SDK sent legacy shape.

alex-qa: repro steps I ran locally (hosted sandbox): 1) Use same payload above -> validator fails at additionalProperties. 2) Remove promo_code and coerce amount to number -> now validator moves on and fails on missing billing.customer_id. 3) Add billing.customer_id -> success. So it's deterministic.

mike-oncall: customer is reporting production failures and some orders dropped. Are they on Dedicated or Hosted? sara-support: Hosted; small but paying tenant. They hit it at scale on a batched retry loop which amplified errors.

james: possible mitigations: a) server-side shim to strip unknown properties from tool_args for hosted tier, b) accept string->number coercion for amount at gateway, c) ask customer to update SDK immediately. Which is fastest?

lena: short-term: gateway shim to strip promo_code and coerce amount (we can do coercion only for numeric-like strings) for hosted customers. Long-term: enforce clients upgrade and send correct billing.customer_id. I can prepare a small validator-layer change to be rolled to prod.

mike-oncall: can infra put a hotfix in place? This is causing billing route failures.

infra-bot: deploy job queued: validator-shim/strip-extra-props @stable -> staging (canary 5%)

james: alex-qa, can you test the shim in staging with the exact payload and confirm end-to-end success including billing routed?

alex-qa: testing now. Will post results in ~10m.

sara-support: CS updated ticket 7654321 with repro and asked customer to disable automated retries for now. Will notify when we have a fix.

lena: plan: push shim canary, monitor for false negatives (we should not strip intentionally used keys in private/dedicated), then follow with a validator config that permits coercion for amount. ETA for canary -> 30m, full rollout -> 2h if no regressions.

james: add a log flag to capture dropped keys for 24h. Also add a metric payments_tool.schema.rejects.count tagged by tenant_id so CS can correlate.

infra-bot: canary deployed to 5% at 1719876600. Monitoring hooks enabled.

alex-qa: canary test passed: shim stripped promo_code, coerced amount to number, billing.customer_id still required — I added it in test and billing routed correctly. No regressions observed in staging logs.

mike-oncall: proceeding with controlled rollout. sara-support: advise customer we'll have a fix in ~2h and include instructions for immediate SDK fix (set amount as number, include billing.customer_id).

sara-support: noted, updating ticket and adding workaround steps. Thanks everyone :heart:
